export_evidence: No export shipment record found. ImportKey page for PIONEER SALES (Basement Floor, S-29 Rajouri Garden, Delhi) shows only inbound lanes: "2026-01-24 | TONGXIANG FERRITE ELECTRONICS CO LTD | PIONEER SALES | EE19/8/5 H(5+5) BOBBIN | Shanghai, CHINA -> PATPARGANJ ICD INPPG6, India | HS 85051110 | BOL 7112919". Top ports listed are only "Shanghai 41" and "PATPARGANJ ICD INPPG6 41" — i.e. a single import lane, no outbound destination port. Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 384 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 2", but the free view rendered only 5 shipment rows (all dated 2026-01-24, all imports) and 5 supplier rows; the 384 figure is a platform counter, not rows actually seen. No bill of lading with an Indian exporter as shipper and a foreign consignee was observed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. Search tooling was unavailable (DuckDuckGo/searx returned connection refused on all queries), and volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. ImportKey shows only customs import activity, which is not evidence of domestic supply. No domestic supply record was seen — but absence here is due to source inaccessibility, not a confirmed negative, hence 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'.
note: Declared HS 880730 (aircraft parts, 'Авиастроение и транспорт') is NOT supported by any observed record. Every customs line seen is HS 85051110 (ferrite cores / bobbins / grinding belts) imported from Chinese suppliers (Tongxiang Ferrite, Hangzhou Global-Star, Tongxiang Huayuan, Tongxiang Feirui) via Shanghai into Patparganj ICD. The company therefore appears to be an importer/trader of electronic components, not an aircraft-parts exporter. Per project rules the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual code should be corrected to 85051110 (import side) and the verdict is accepted_hs_corrected with this caveat. One ambiguous signal worth flagging for manual review, not treated as evidence: the ImportKey 'Buyers' block lists a Russian consignee address ("EASTERN WAY LIMITED TRADE DEVELOPME ... ULYANOVSK REGION-433405 RUSSIA") in a row that also names 'Pioneer Sales' and 'ASCEND AEROSPARES PRIVATE LIMITED' — this is a shared-counterparty aggregation row, not a dated shipment with BOL, so it cannot be counted as an export record. Legal name 'RANJIT SINGH' as proprietor and PAN were not verifiable from any accessible source; revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources, not estimated). Bottom line: следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено; по внутреннему рынку данных получить не удалось.
